FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TalentLink Recruiting Services specializes in connecting employers with top talent through precise recruitment strategies. Our core operations involve sourcing, screening, and placing candidates across various industries, focusing primarily on non-regulated sectors such as information technology, marketing, and finance. We ensure all candidates undergo thorough background checks and work eligibility verification to uphold compliance and mitigate potential risks for both clients and job seekers.

We maintain all necessary state and federal licenses for our operations, ensuring our practices align with regulatory requirements. Our team excels in utilizing advanced applicant tracking systems to manage candidate information securely, adhering to all applicable privacy laws. Additionally, we provide detailed written contracts that outline the terms of service for both clients and candidates, minimizing disputes and clearly defining responsibilities. 

TalentLink is dedicated to fostering long-term relationships with both clients and candidates, offering ongoing support post-placement to ensure satisfaction on both ends. We are committed to maintaining accurate records of all placements and transactions, reinforcing our reliability and professionalism in the recruitment sector.
